name: @insolvia-ai/tokens
description: Design tokens: one JSON source of truth rendered into typed TypeScript for React Native, CSS custom properties for the web, and plain JSON for tools with no compiler.
//: PUBLISHED as of 0.2.0. It was `private: true` through 0.1.x, when every
consumer was a workspace sibling resolving it by symlink — there was
nothing to publish and no version to gate. Consumers are across a repo
boundary now, so the registry is the only way to reach them.
tool/generate-tokens.ts from tokens.json — never hand-edit either; see
README.md. `npm run tokens:check` fails CI on drift.
The exports point at TypeScript SOURCE, not a build output, and there is
deliberately no compile step: bundlers and Node >=24 both consume .ts
directly, so a build here would only add a way for them to disagree.
`./colors.json` is the exception that proves it. Node's type-stripping
refuses .ts under node_modules, so a plain `node` script in a consumer
with no bundler cannot import the TypeScript at all. It gets the same
colours as data rather than a second implementation of the blend maths.
The generator's COLORS_JSON_OUT comment carries the full reasoning.
//files: tokens.json ships too, though nothing imports it. It is the source both
generated files are rendered from, and a published artifact that carries
its own input is one a consumer can audit: diff the shipped tokens.json
against this repo's and you know whether the artifact is honest. It is a
couple of kilobytes of pure data — the cheapest provenance available.
